questions.q: What does a distribution on a requisition line specify?
options: The accounting - how much of the line's cost is charged to which account
The supplier's bank routing number
The approval routing rule for the requisition
The receiving location for the shipment
questions.explain: A distribution captures the accounting detail: the charge account (and any split) for the line's cost.

questions.q: Where does the charge account on Dana's distribution come from?
options: Dana types it in manually from memory
It defaults from Enterprise Structures and Chart of Accounts setup, based on factors like her cost center and the item category
It is always the same account for every company regardless of setup
It is selected randomly by the system
questions.explain: The charge account defaults based on configured rules drawing on the requester's cost center, default account, and item category - not manual entry.

questions.q: Why does the PB-4400 bearing default to a maintenance expense account rather than an inventory account?
options: Because all purchases default to the same account regardless of category
Because Dana requested it personally
Because it is categorized as an MRO expense item rather than a stocked inventory asset item
Because the supplier is Meridian Bearing Supply Co.
questions.explain: The item category - MRO expense versus stocked inventory - is one of the factors driving which type of account the distribution defaults to.

options: A hold placed on a supplier's invoice
A penalty charged to a requester for submitting too many requisitions
A type of purchase order used only for capital assets
A budgetary journal that reserves funds against a budget when a requisition is approved, before any purchase order exists
questions.explain: If encumbrance accounting is enabled, approving a requisition can reserve budget immediately through a requisition encumbrance, protecting against over-commitment.

questions.q: What happens to the requisition encumbrance once the requisition is converted into a purchase order?
options: Nothing changes; both encumbrances remain permanently, double-counting the reservation
The encumbrance is deleted and the budget is no longer reserved at all
The requisition encumbrance reverses and a purchase order encumbrance takes its place, carrying the reservation forward
The encumbrance converts directly into a paid invoice
questions.explain: When a requisition becomes a purchase order, its encumbrance reverses and is replaced by a purchase order encumbrance, avoiding double-counting the same commitment.
